tasks.short: Signal crew members for engine or train movement

steps.what: Observe crew positions and immediate movement conditions
Determine the intended movement communication and appropriate signalling means
Signal crew members using hand signals, lanterns, radios or telephones
Confirm crew understanding and monitor the signalling exchange
outputs: confirmed exchange or need to clarify

tasks.previous_blocker: The communication depends on the actual vehicle, crew and conditions at that moment.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported reduction in this physical signalling episode is identified.
tasks.still_hard: Unambiguous timing and shared understanding during changing yard movements.
tasks.human_edge: Immediate situational judgement and clear signalling.

reach.learn: Separate the intended signal from confirmation it was understood

evidence.claim: The digest's paperwork and rostering capabilities do not replace hand, lantern or radio movement signalling.

tasks.short: Exchange switching information with conductors and other workers

Listen to conductors and workers and clarify switching information
Resolve inconsistent switching details and determine the response
Communicate checked switching information and confirm shared understanding
Write switching exchange notes and unresolved details

tasks.previous_blocker: Current references and repeated exchange-note fields require manual handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and note structures can reduce small amounts of clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling changing switching information and ensuring colleagues share the same understanding.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated lookup and record handling around the exchange.

reach.learn: Make order version and unresolved details explicit

tasks.short: Read switching instructions and schedules to determine work

Read instructions and receive yard conductor orders
Determine work to be performed and resolve instruction conflicts
outputs: clarified work sequence and unresolved matters

steps.what: Write working notes for switching tasks and schedule references
inputs: clarified work sequence and unresolved matters

tasks.enabler_now: Native current-order views and linked note fields can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting the applicable order and resolving discrepancies in a changing yard.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding what the work requires in the real operating context.
tasks.altitude: Less reference handling before the engineer performs the work.
